Question B-006-010-005.

Why the correct answer is right: A roof-mounted quarter-wave vertical is approximately omnidirectional in the horizontal plane.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "It goes out equally well in all horizontal directions": Correct. A roof-mounted quarter-wave vertical is approximately omnidirectional in the horizontal plane.
- sourceIndex 1: "Most of it goes vertically straight-up": The listed polarization must match the element orientation described in the question.
- sourceIndex 2: "Most of it goes equally in two opposite directions": A quarter-wave vertical on a good vehicle roof is roughly omnidirectional around the horizon.
- sourceIndex 3: "Most of it goes in one direction": A quarter-wave vertical on a good vehicle roof is roughly omnidirectional around the horizon.
